During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an '''individual''' acquired the [[Battle droid/Legends|military droid]] [[K1-1R]]. The individual later sent K1-1R on a suicide mission, and the droid subsequently abandoned his master after his survival programing overrode his sense of loyalty to his owner.
